event_summary: A green sheet spanning between two handled tools bends, splits near the center, and ends as two separated green pieces on a tabletop.
raw_event_description: At the start, a bright green rectangular sheet is stretched across the middle of a wooden tabletop between two black-and-blue handled tools at the left and right edges. The sheet remains mostly flat for several moments with a slightly curved front edge. Then the central area rises and twists, a visible separation opens near the center, and the left and right portions bend away from each other. By the end, two separate green pieces are visible with a gap between them, each near one of the handled tools.

reasons: The green sheet is fully visible in the center.
The two handled tools are partially visible at the left and right sides.
The tabletop and background are visible.
